definition: Assessing surgical performance from video or kinematic data — automated skill scoring for training and certification.
details: Assessing surgical performance from video or kinematic data — automated skill scoring for training and certification.

explainer.lead: Surgical skills evaluation scores surgical performance automatically from video or kinematic data, serving training and certification. It matters because automated scoring can make skill assessment more consistent than manual review.

tiers.eli5: It's like a coach watching a surgery recording and giving the trainee a score on how well they did.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers build systems that score surgical performance from video or motion (kinematic) data for training and certification. A pitfall is that scores are only as trustworthy as the data and criteria behind them.
tiers.paperLevel: Assessing surgical performance from video or kinematic data, producing automated skill scores for training and certification. Scoring quality depends on the underlying data.

explainer.example: Scoring a trainee's recorded procedure from video to produce an automated skill rating for certification.
